stem: A hose repeatedly crosses the only clear aisle in a flower room. Staff have been told to step over it, but two near misses have occurred. Which response best follows the hierarchy of controls?
choices: Reroute or physically secure the hose so the aisle remains clear, then verify the change works
Repeat the verbal warning at every shift
Require brighter clothing so workers notice the hose
Leave the hose unchanged because no injury has occurred
rationale: A source/engineering-style correction is stronger than repeated reminders and should be verified after implementation.
